name: cfb-ranking-algorithm
install:
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv python3-pip
python3 -m venv venv
./venv/bin/pip install -U pip
./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
./venv/bin/pip install flake8 bandit pytest pytest-cov
(cd frontend && npm ci)
start: echo 'Secrets (MINIMAX_API_KEY, CFBD_API_KEY) are injected from the Cursor Cloud Secrets tab — see .cursor/SECRETS.md'
